parameters.doc_value: any electrical public utility subject to IURC jurisdiction
parameters.s1_quote: These rules shall apply to any electrical public utility subject to the jurisdiction of the commission pursuant to the provisions of the Public Service Commission Act [ IC 8-1-2 ]

parameters.name: Commission definition
parameters.s1_quote: "Commission" means the Indiana utility regulatory commission.

parameters.name: IURC reporting trigger
parameters.doc_value: accident attended with loss of human life occurs within this state upon its premises, or directly or indirectly arising from or connected with its maintenance or operation
parameters.s1_quote: whenever an accident attended with loss of human life occurs within this state upon its premises, or directly or indirectly arising from or connected with its maintenance or operation, give immediate notice thereof to the commission

parameters.name: business-day telephone timing
parameters.doc_value: as soon as possible after being informed of such an accident
parameters.s1_quote: as soon as possible after being informed of such an accident, and if such accident occurs during a regular business day, inform the commission by telephone of pertinent details of the accident including the name of the deceased

parameters.name: telephone content — pertinent details
parameters.s1_quote: inform the commission by telephone of pertinent details of the accident including the name of the deceased

parameters.name: telephone content — name of deceased

parameters.name: non-business-day telephone timing
parameters.doc_value: as early as practical the first business day following the accident
parameters.s1_quote: If the accident occurs during a period other than a regular business day the commission shall be so informed as early as practical the first business day following the accident.

parameters.name: written report trigger
parameters.doc_value: as soon as all pertinent information has been accumulated
parameters.s1_quote: a written report of the fatal accident as soon as all pertinent information has been accumulated, such report will be filed in the appropriate commission files and available upon proper request or order

parameters.name: records retention minimum
parameters.s1_quote: All records required by these rules shall be preserved for at least three years except as otherwise provided herein or by IC 8-1-2-40

parameters.name: records location — within state

parameters.s1_quote: Such records shall be kept within the State at the principal place of business of the public utility, or at such other places as the utility shall designate after notification to the commission, and shall be open for examination by the commission or its representatives.

interpretations.question: What constitutes a 'regular business day' for purposes of the IURC telephone notification timing branches in 170 IAC 4-1-24?
interpretations.position: RPL defines 'regular business day' as a day on which the IURC is open for business: Monday through Friday, not a State of Indiana public holiday, between 8:15 a.m. and 4:45 p.m. ET. Weekends and Indiana state holidays are outside regular business hours.
interpretations.rationale: 170 IAC 4-1-24 uses the phrase 'regular business day' without defining it. The IURC's published operating hours (§1.6 Table X: 8:15 a.m.–4:45 p.m. ET, Monday–Friday) represent the most operationally direct definition because the telephone notice must reach the Commission. RPL has chosen the reading that extends the notification obligation most broadly: any accident outside these hours triggers the after-hours branch, ensuring the Commission is notified as soon as it is open to receive the call.

interpretations.question: When a Tier 1 hospitalized event results in the patient's death, at what point does the IURC notification obligation in 170 IAC 4-1-24 attach?
interpretations.position: The notification obligation attaches at the time RPL is informed that the person has died. The clock under 170 IAC 4-1-24 ('as soon as possible after being informed of such an accident') runs from when RPL is informed of the fatal outcome, not from the original incident time.
interpretations.rationale: 170 IAC 4-1-24 refers to 'an accident attended with loss of human life.' A hospitalization that later results in death meets this condition upon the death occurring. The pack's telephone timing ('as soon as possible after being informed') is triggered by RPL being informed — which in a delayed-death scenario is when RPL learns of the fatality.

interpretations.question: Does the IURC reporting requirement in 170 IAC 4-1-24 apply when the deceased is a third-party member of the public (not an RPL employee or contractor) who contacts RPL distribution facilities?
interpretations.position: Yes. 170 IAC 4-1-24 applies whenever an accident attended with loss of human life arises 'directly or indirectly' from the utility's 'maintenance or operation.' Contact with an energized RPL distribution facility by a member of the public is an event arising from RPL's maintenance or operation of that facility.
interpretations.rationale: The pack uses the broad nexus 'directly or indirectly arising from or connected with its maintenance or operation,' which encompasses incidents involving members of the public who contact RPL distribution equipment. RPL reads this broadly to include the CUST category.
